# Aegis Softtech

> Aegis Softtech is an ISO-certified software development company based in India with 20+ years of experience delivering AI, cloud, data, and enterprise software solutions to global enterprises and startups. The company operates as a Global Capability Center (GCC), offering deep technical expertise with a client-first, partnership-oriented approach.

## Company Overview

Website: [aegissofttech.com](https://www.aegissofttech.com): Main homepage of Aegis Softtech, an ISO-certified software development company.
Founded: 20+ years ago
Headquarters: Rajkot, Gujarat, India
Team Size: 350+ skilled experts
Projects Delivered: 500+ across industries
Clients: 100+ globally (US, UK, Australia, Europe, Singapore, Middle East, Canada)
Ratings: Google Reviews 4.6/5; listed on Clutch, GoodFirms, Crunchbase, and SuperbCompanies
Notable Clients: Reliance, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Zydus, Sterling Hospitals, Nirma, Ajio, efacec
Contact: Toll Free 1800 889 7020 | info@aegissofttech.com
Free Trial: 10-day free trial available

## Engagement Models

- **Fixed-Price Model:** Best for well-scoped projects â€” MVPs, product modernization, fixed deliverables.
- **Time & Material Model:** Best for evolving requirements, agile projects, R&D, ongoing improvements. Pay only for actual time and effort.
- **Dedicated Team Model:** Best for long-term enterprise partnerships. Developers, architects, QA, and PMs work exclusively on client goals.
